_doc: Active regression probes for /bma-simulate. Each probe is a closed bug that the next simulator run must re-verify so the fix doesn't silently regress. Probes are prepended to the SCENARIO_PLAN in Phase A.

_schema.id: bug ID matching the sprint that fixed it
_schema.preconditions: human-readable state the driver should be in before running this probe (the orchestrator decides where to insert the probe in the scenario)

trigger.type: 'evaluate' (call evaluate_js) or 'mouse_sequence' (run a list of mouse actions in PDF coords)

_schema.assertion_js: () => boolean — returns true iff the fix is still in place
_schema.cleanup_js: () => { ... } — restore neutral state so subsequent scenario steps are unaffected

probes.description: Page Setup modal (#setupModal) must be a child of #stage (NOT nested inside #modal) and render with non-zero rect when openSetup() runs.
probes.preconditions: PDF loaded (caseId set, curImg non-null). Do not nest inside another modal flow.
probes.assertion_js: () => { var m=document.getElementById('setupModal'); if(!m)return false; var r=m.getBoundingClientRect(); var parentOk=m.parentElement && m.parentElement.id==='stage'; var sel=document.querySelector('#su-floor select.fc-tag'); var selOk=sel && !!sel.offsetParent; return r.width>100 && r.height>100 && parentOk && selOk; }

probes.description: Polygon dblclick at the same screen position as the last click MUST preserve the intentional vertex (final polygon has 4 pts, not 3). Asserts the bounded pop-loop cap of 2 — for(_np<2) — in the cv dblclick handler; the old unbounded while-loop also consumed the intentional 4th vertex (713 m2 quad silently saved as 356 m2 triangle).
probes.preconditions: PDF loaded (pageData/curImg set so ptToScreen works). Evaluate-only and self-contained: resets the CURRENT page's objects + scale + poly tool, injects a 6-pt draft (4 intentional vertices + the 2 stray points the dblclick's own mousedowns would have pushed at the dblclick spot), then dispatches a synthetic dblclick MouseEvent directly on #cv. No real mouse events, so modals/wizards/LWIZ overlays in front of the canvas cannot break it (rewritten 2026-07-03 from mouse_sequence for exactly that reason).

trigger.evaluate_js: () => { var pg=PSpage(); pg.objects=[]; pg.scale={pts_per_m:30.0}; state.catLock[state.activeCat]=false; setTool('poly'); var p1={x:84.2,y:119.1},p2={x:757.8,y:119.1},p3={x:757.8,y:1071.9},p4={x:84.2,y:1071.9}; state.draft=[p1,p2,p3,p4,{x:p4.x,y:p4.y},{x:p4.x,y:p4.y}]; var sp=ptToScreen(p4), r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(); cv.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:r.left+sp.x,clientY:r.top+sp.y})); var objs=PSpage().objects; var nPts=(objs.length===1&&objs[0].pts)?objs[0].pts.length:-1; return {pass:(objs.length===1&&nPts===4), nObjs:objs.length, nPts:nPts, draftCleared:(state.draft===null)}; }

probes.assertion_js: () => { var pg=PSpage(); var objs=pg && pg.objects; if(!objs || objs.length!==1)return false; return !!(objs[0].pts && objs[0].pts.length===4); }
